headline: Another incident in the Strait of Hormuz: Merchant ship hit by unknown projectile
summary: A merchant ship was hit by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz overnight, about 37 km northeast of the Omani city of Khasab, according to UKMTO. The incident adds to escalating tension on a key oil and gas route.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a chokepoint through which a large share of seaborne oil and LNG passes, so disruptions there can quickly affect energy prices and shipping costs.
why_moved: Escalating tension on the Strait of Hormuz, a key oil and gas transport route, raises fears of supply disruption.
